# Contributing to OvCompute

First off, thank you for considering contributing to OvCompute! It's people like you that make OvCompute such a great tool.

## Where do I go from here?

If you've noticed a bug or have a feature request, make sure to check our [Issues](https://github.com/ovishkh/Al-powered_multi-threaded_highly-scalable_calculator/issues) first to see if someone else has already created it. If not, feel free to open a new one!

## Fork & create a branch

If this is something you think you can fix, then fork OvCompute and create a branch with a descriptive name.

## Get the test suite running

Make sure you have the necessary dependencies installed for the respective microservice you are working on (Node.js, Go, Python). See the `README.md` for instructions on how to start the local infrastructure.

## Implement your fix or feature

At this point, you're ready to make your changes! Feel free to ask for help; everyone is a beginner at first.

## Make a Pull Request

At this point, you should switch back to your master branch and make sure it's up to date with OvCompute's master branch.
Then create a pull request with a clear description of the changes you've made.
